fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-Criminal Record Certificate Issued by local authorities within six months of the application date. * 2. Recommendation Letters Two letters signed by high school teachers, stating their relationship with the applicant. * 3. Personal Statement Study plan and motivation, 800+ words in Chinese or English. You can download a template or sample from here . * 4. Financial Proof Documents demonstrating financial support, such as income certificates, bank statements, or sponsor letters. * 5. Physical Examination Form and the Report on Blood Examination A photocopy (the original should be kept by the applicant). This form is issued by the Chinese quarantine authorities and must be completed in English. Applicants must strictly follow the requirements listed on the form. Forms with missing items, no applicant photo, photos without a cross-page stamp, or without the signature and official seal of the attending physician and hospital will be deemed invalid. The examination results are valid for 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Supporting Documents Award certificates, proof of skills, if any. * 7. Passport A scanned copy of the passport information page (valid for at least 12 months). * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Academic transcript Official transcripts for high school studies, stamped by the school. If not in Chinese or English, provide notarized translations. * 10. Academic Certificates Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Highest degree certificate notarized. If the applicant is currently enrolled, provide a certificate of expected graduation. * 11. English proficiency test certificate * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health both physically and mentally with good academic background, observe Chinese laws as well as university rules and regulations, and respect Chinese customs. 2. Language proficiency requirements: ● English-taught programs: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 80, Duolingo 90 or equivalent 3. Academic and Age Requirements: Completed high school, and be under 26 years old
